title: Gradient-Controlled Decoding: A Safety Guardrail for LLMs with Dual-Anchor Steering
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical safety guardrails for LLMs to prevent jailbreaking and prompt injection. It evaluates performance on toxicity and refusal benchmarks (ToxicChat, XSTest, AdvBench) but does not specifically study religion, faith, or formal ethical/moral systems.
